export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/auto-ignition-limited) shows 8508 total shipment records, 115 trading partners, 75 port lanes, latest cargo 2026-02-28. Exact row quoted: "2026-02-28 | AUTO IGNITION LIMITED | WETHERILL ASSOCIATES INCORPORATED | VOLTAGE REGULATOR VRD6006 (81-1906)- | TUGLAKABAD ICD INTKD6, India -> Memphis, UNITED STATES | HS 85119000 | BOL 1118427". Further rows seen: 2026-02-27 -> Manzanillo, MEXICO, HS 85115000, BOL 1067798 (SERV ADMINST INDUST S DE R L DE C.V); 2026-02-26 -> Southampton, UNITED KINGDOM, HS 85119000, BOL 1054602 (WAI-UK LTD); 2026-02-24 -> Colombo, Sri Lanka, HS 85119000, BOL 9973150 (M. SENEVIRATNE (PVT.) LTD). Counter check: page claims 8508 records; only 5 dated rows were visible in the free view (plus supplier/buyer aggregate tables), so the 8508 figure is the platform's counter, not independently verified row-by-row. Declared HS 851190 matches the observed export HS 85119000 (voltage regulators / starter-motor parts) - no HS correction needed.
domestic_evidence: No domestic supply record could be retrieved: web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) and the registry/financial aggregators tried (thecompanycheck.com, zaubacorp.com, tofler.in) returned HTTP 403/404. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report domestic/export splits are therefore null - not public in the sources reachable within this check.
note: Real export shipments are confirmed by dated customs/B-L rows with destination, HS code and BOL number (US, Mexico, UK, Sri Lanka; latest 2026-02-28), so this is not a 'declared only' case. The company also appears as an importer in the same dataset (e.g. 2026-02-25 inbound from Liaoning World Electrical Appliance, China, HS 85119000, BOL 7728780), i.e. it both imports components and exports finished assemblies - consistent with a manufacturer role, though role is outside this check's scope. Domestic (India) supply evidence was not verifiable: search tooling was down and financial aggregators blocked, so domestic_status is 'unknown' rather than 'none_found' - absence of evidence here is a tooling limitation, not proof of no domestic sales. Revenue and export volume figures: null (not public in free views).
